items.title: 2 reference photos · Night Embrace Under a Street Lamp
items.prompt: An ultra photorealistic candid moment under a lone street lamp on a quiet empty street at night, capturing two people standing extremely close with no one else around. The person behind wraps both arms around the one in front in a natural embrace while the one leaning back rests with softly closed eyes and a genuine small smile, both swaying gently as if sharing a private melody. The two faces are derived directly from uploaded reference images, with original hairstyles, hair textures, and colors preserved. Both wear realistic evening attire with natural fabric textures. Shot with a 50mm handheld lens at f/1.8, featuring shallow depth of field blurring the empty street and distant urban backdrop while keeping the subjects sharp, framed as a slightly off-center medium shot at eye-level with subtle handheld realism. Single warm street lamp light acts as the sole illumination — soft amber glow creating uneven highlights on faces and shoulders with gentle shadows, revealing skin texture with visible pores and soft evening sheen, no AI beauty filters or plastic smoothing. Natural weight distribution with relaxed shoulders, correct arm anatomy and finger placement around waist without warping, no body intersection, no floating limbs. Deep blacks, warm amber tones against the empty dark street. No rings, text, watermarks, logos, studio lighting, perfect symmetry, or posed editorial aesthetics.

items.title: 2 reference photos · Midnight Carry on the Sidewalk
items.prompt: An ultra photorealistic candid night scene on an elegant sidewalk after an evening out, capturing one person carrying the other securely in their arms in a natural bridal-style lift. They face each other with soft affectionate smiles, calm eyes, and relaxed cheeks radiating romantic warmth without exaggerated laughter. The two faces are derived directly from uploaded reference images, with original hairstyles, hair textures, and colors preserved. Both wear elegant evening attire with realistic fabric folds and natural creases. Shot with a 50mm cinematic lens at f/1.8, featuring soft shallow depth of field blurring the warm urban background while keeping the subjects sharp, framed as a medium-full shot at eye-level. Correct anatomy with secure arm support under the back and knees, natural weight distribution, proper finger placement without warping, realistic fabric compression at contact points, and no floating limbs or body intersection. Warm amber tones against deep evening shadows. No rings, text, watermarks, logos, studio lighting, perfect symmetry, or fashion editorial posing.

items.title: 2 reference photos · Shared Umbrella in the Rain
items.prompt: An ultra photorealistic candid moment on a quiet rainy city street during evening blue hour, capturing two people hurrying together under a single umbrella. They move quickly with shoulders pressed close, sharing genuine laughter with soft affectionate eyes and relaxed faces, one person holding the umbrella while the other naturally leans into them. The two faces are derived directly from uploaded reference images, with original hairstyles, hair textures, and colors preserved. Both wear soft elegant rainy-evening attire with realistic slightly damp fabric textures. Shot with a 35mm cinematic street lens at f/2, featuring moderate shallow depth of field keeping rain reflections and background lights readable, framed as a medium-wide candid shot at natural eye-level with subtle motion blur in rain and movement suggesting handheld realism. Real street and shopfront lighting casts warm reflections on wet pavement alongside cool rainy ambient light, gentle highlights on umbrella edges and cheeks, revealing natural skin texture with visible pores and slight rain sheen — no AI beauty filters or plastic smoothing. Natural hurried posture with realistic stride, shoulder alignment, and slight imbalance from motion, correct umbrella grip with proper finger anatomy, no warped hands or extra fingers, believable damp fabric response. Wet asphalt blue-gray tones with warm amber reflections. No rings, text, watermarks, logos, studio lighting, perfect symmetry, or fashion editorial aesthetics.

items.prompt: An ultra photorealistic candid moment along the shoreline during golden hour, capturing two people playfully chasing each other at the water's edge. The two faces are derived directly from uploaded reference images, with original hairstyles, hair textures, and colors preserved. Shot with a 35mm action lifestyle lens at f/2.2, featuring moderate shallow depth of field and subtle natural motion blur in limbs, framed as a wide candid shot at slightly low angle emphasizing dynamic energy. Natural sunlight creates warm reflections off ocean waves and wet sand, dynamic highlights on skin with soft shadow transitions, revealing authentic skin texture with visible pores and slight water sheen — no AI beauty filters or plastic smoothing. Correct anatomy with realistic muscle tension and joint angles, no floating limbs, no body intersection, no stiff posing. Warm gold sunlight, ocean turquoise, sand tones. No rings, text, watermarks, logos, studio lighting, perfect symmetry, or fashion shoot aesthetics.

items.title: 2 reference photos · Castle Archway at Dusk
items.prompt: An ultra photorealistic candid moment in an elegant grand hall of a historic European castle, tall arched windows with soft diffused natural light streaming through, ornate carved stone archways, capturing two people framed within a grand stone archway. They stand face to face within the arch, bodies turned in three-quarter profile toward the camera, hands gently clasped between them, both looking at each other with soft affectionate eyes and gentle relaxed smiles, the carved stone arch creating a natural frame around them like a living portrait against the grand hall beyond. The two faces are derived directly from the uploaded reference images, with their original hairstyles, hair textures, and colors strictly preserved. Both wear elegant wedding attire with natural fabric textures. Shot with a 50mm lens at f/2.2, featuring shallow depth of field blurring the grand hall beyond the arch while keeping subjects and the archway detail sharp, framed as a medium shot at natural eye-level. Soft diffused natural window light from the arch creates gentle gradients on their faces with subtle shadows, revealing skin texture with visible pores, no AI beauty filters, no plastic smoothing. Natural weight distribution with correct standing posture and arm anatomy, no body intersection, no floating limbs. Soft ivory, warm amber, and antique stone grey tones. No rings, text, watermarks, logos, or studio lighting.

items.title: 2 reference photos · Tropical Island Cliff Walk
items.prompt: An ultra photorealistic candid moment on a dramatic clifftop overlooking the vast ocean at sunset, tropical greenery and wild frangipani framing the edge, warm golden light reflecting off the turquoise water far below and distant coastline fading into warm atmospheric haze, capturing two people walking hand in hand along a narrow cliff path. They move with natural graceful stride, bodies turned in three-quarter profile toward the camera, the bride's flowing silk sarong and delicate kebaya hem stirred by the tropical breeze while the groom's ceremonial shirt catches the warm light, both sharing soft genuine smiles as they take in the vast ocean view. The two faces are derived directly from the uploaded reference images, with their original hairstyles, hair textures, and colors strictly preserved. Both wear traditional Balinese wedding attire with natural fabric textures, the bride in a white kebaya with intricate gold embroidery and flowing silk sarong with a golden crown (gelung) adorned with frangipani flowers, and the groom in a white ceremonial shirt with gold trim and traditional headwrap. Shot with a 35mm lens at f/2.8, featuring moderate depth of field keeping both subjects and the dramatic cliff edge sharp while softly blurring the distant ocean horizon, framed as a wide full-body shot at natural eye-level. Warm golden hour sunlight from the tropical sunset creates uneven rim light on their hair and shoulders with soft shadows on their faces, revealing skin texture with visible pores, no AI beauty filters, no plastic smoothing. Natural weight distribution with correct walking posture and arm anatomy, no body intersection, no floating limbs. Soft ivory, tropical gold, and warm ocean turquoise tones. No rings, text, watermarks, logos, or studio lighting.

items.title: 2 reference photos · Spanish Olive Grove Embrace
items.prompt: An ultra photorealistic candid moment in a charming Andalusian white village garden, ancient olive trees with silver-green leaves, whitewashed walls in the background, warm Mediterranean afternoon light filtering through the branches, capturing two people sharing a natural embrace beneath an olive tree. The groom stands behind wrapping arms gently around the bride's waist, both bodies turned in three-quarter profile toward the camera, their heads tilted together as they gaze at each other with soft affectionate eyes and genuine relaxed smiles, the warm breeze stirring the bride's mantilla veil and the olive leaves around them. The two faces are derived directly from the uploaded reference images, with their original hairstyles, hair textures, and colors strictly preserved. Both wear Spanish-inspired wedding attire with natural fabric textures, the bride in an elegant white lace dress with a delicate mantilla veil, and the groom in a formal black suit with a crisp white shirt. Shot with an 85mm portrait lens at f/2, featuring shallow depth of field blurring the whitewashed walls and olive branches while keeping subjects sharp, framed as a medium close-up at natural eye-level. Warm Mediterranean afternoon light filtering through olive leaves creates gentle dappled light on their faces with soft shadows, revealing skin texture with visible pores, no AI beauty filters, no plastic smoothing. Natural weight distribution with correct arm and waist anatomy, no body intersection, no floating limbs. Soft ivory, silver-green, and warm Mediterranean gold tones. No rings, text, watermarks, logos, or studio lighting.

items.title: 2 reference photos · Chinese Moon Gate Portrait
items.prompt: An ultra photorealistic candid moment in a serene traditional Chinese garden, a circular moon gate framed by climbing vines and delicate plum blossoms, grey-tiled roofs visible beyond, soft diffused light, capturing two people standing face to face within a moon gate. They stand close with hands gently clasped in the traditional Chinese gesture, bodies turned in three-quarter profile toward the camera, both looking at each other with soft affectionate eyes and gentle restrained smiles, the moon gate creating a perfect circular frame around them like a jade pendant. The two faces are derived directly from the uploaded reference images, with their original hairstyles, hair textures, and colors strictly preserved. Both wear traditional Chinese wedding attire with natural fabric textures, the bride in a traditional red xiuhefu wedding gown with intricate gold embroidery and phoenix patterns and delicate gold hairpins in an elaborate updo, and the groom in a black traditional changshan robe with subtle gold trim and mandarin collar. Shot with a 50mm lens at f/2.2, featuring shallow depth of field blurring the garden beyond the moon gate while keeping subjects and the stone arch sharp, framed as a medium shot at natural eye-level. Soft diffused natural light filtering through the vines creates gentle gradients on their faces with subtle shadows, revealing skin texture with visible pores, no AI beauty filters, no plastic smoothing. Natural weight distribution with correct standing posture and hand anatomy, no body intersection, no floating limbs. Imperial red, jade green, and antique gold tones. No rings, text, watermarks, logos, or studio lighting.
